# Preserved upstream automation

These files are unchanged snapshots of the workflows from CPA Plus `v7.3.12-1`. The `.disabled` suffix and location outside `.github/workflows/` keep them inactive in this fork. Original authorship and the root MIT license are retained.

They reference upstream release conventions, synchronization policies, registry names and self-hosted runners. This fork supplies its own CI and manual prerelease workflow instead. Restoring a workflow requires adapting those assumptions first.
